call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Software Acceleration (+9% CC) & Data (+20% CC) vs. Automation (-3%)
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Arvind, Software grew 9% at constant currency with Data surging 20% CC and Red Hat up 11%, while Automation dipped 3%. What is driving the breakout in Data and how sustainable is double-digit Software profit growth?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Arvind Krishna explained that enterprise clients are now deploying Super Intelligence to transform entire operating models rather than isolated pilots, which requires massive data governance, vectorization, and hybrid cloud orchestration—directly fueling the +20% CC surge in IBM Data and +11% growth in Red Hat. Segment profit margin in Software expanded +210 bps YoY to 35.0% ($2,734M).

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Distributed Infrastructure Breakout (+31% YoY) vs. IBM Z Cycle (-20% YoY)
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Jim, Distributed Infrastructure jumped 31% YoY (32% CC) while IBM Z declined 20% late in the z16 cycle. What drove the Distributed Infrastructure surge, and how does the full-year FCF raise to >$1B YoY bridge into Q4?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CFO James Kavanaugh highlighted that AI-optimized Power10 and storage clusters for enterprise hybrid clouds drove the 31% surge in Distributed Infrastructure, lifting total Infrastructure up 4.2% YoY ($3,707M) despite the late-stage IBM Z product cycle. Combined with internal AI productivity savings, Q3 GAAP OCF rose $944M YoY to $4,025M (FCF $3,027M), giving high confidence in raising FY26 FCF growth to >$1B YoY.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Consulting Constant Currency Inflection (+1.8% CC) & Margin Trajectory
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Consulting revenue was flat reported ($5,335M) and up 1.8% in constant currency, with Strategy & Technology up 4% CC. When do you expect AI transformation signings to re-accelerate total Consulting growth back to mid-single digits?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Management noted that Strategy & Technology (+4% CC) is leading the enterprise AI architecture wave, while clients remain selective on traditional BPO/Intelligent Operations (flat CC). Consulting backlog remains healthy and should inflect further in 2027 as Super Intelligence implementations move from architecture into production deployment.
